abstract: Reviews statutory conservation covenants, watershed protection buffers, and ecological impact declarations
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees environmental compliance, evaluating statutory conservation covenants, watershed protection buffers, and ecological impact declarations across prospective aquifer recharge projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Reviews statutory conservation covenants, watershed protection buffers, and ecological impact declarations（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-N3T：For the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme, environmental buffer covenant registration is confirmed, with a formal legal covenant recorded covering the 500-meter sanitary protection radius around all candidate wellhead collars.
ENV-ECOL-S0P：For the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme, a formal environmental buffer covenant has been registered in the land registry deed office, establishing a legally recorded sanitary protection radius of 500 meters around all candidate wellhead collars to prevent industrial or agricultural runoff.
ENV-ECOL-2TU：For the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme, environmental buffer covenant registration has not been completed; no formal legal covenant preventing industrial or agricultural runoff is recorded within the 500-meter sanitary protection radius around candidate wellhead collars.

information_points.title: Riparian zone bio-assessment（RIPAR）
information_points.content:
ENV-RIPAR-KXI：Biomonitoring surveys for surface watercourses within two kilometers of the Alluvial Valley Deep Well Injection Scheme wellhead arrays record a riparian macroinvertebrate health index of 55 points.
ENV-RIPAR-XP8：Biomonitoring surveys for surface watercourses within two kilometers of the Fractured Basalt Bedrock Pressure-Infiltration Scheme wellhead arrays reflect a riparian macroinvertebrate health index of 68 points.
ENV-RIPAR-VPN：Biomonitoring surveys for surface watercourses within two kilometers of the Coastal Confined Dual-Zone Recharge Scheme wellhead arrays show a riparian macroinvertebrate health index of 91 points.
